snippet.title: Lyncis🛹Speed and Lens | New Simulacrum Trailer | Tower of Fantasy
snippet.description:
Ver.5.0 #KailoSector will be available from 5/13!

"Trying to apply as my stream assistant? Sorry, I run this show solo—no team here." 🛹
"You again? I still don't need an assistant. But if you want a side gig in OreZero, I could hook you up." 🎨
"Back already? Alright, I'll give you a shot. Take this camera, follow me, and snap my coolest skateboard tricks. If you get the perfect shot, you're in." 🤳🏻

#TowerofFantasy #ToF

Bring your friends and let's #ToFgether!

▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△▼△
